description: Manual ground-truth track classifications for controlled demonstration and validation of the child safety policy in a residential playground environment (Scenario A). These labels are for testing and evaluation only, NOT for operational surveillance or autonomous demographic profiling.
provisional_ground_truth_notice: Track 1 is manually designated as PROVISIONAL ground-truth child annotation specifically for this synthetic evaluation experiment. Actual ground truth cannot be independently verified from demo video metadata, and visual appearance age inference is strictly NOT performed.

1.notes: Provisional ground truth: child playing in sandbox, moving to perimeter boundary, and dwelling in fence/hedge hazard zone beyond dwell threshold. Manually assigned for synthetic experiment validation; cannot be independently established from demo metadata.

2.notes: Adult supervisor seated near toddler sandbox bench. Strictly excluded from child alerts.

discontinuity_policy.handling: Track IDs are ephemeral ByteTrack assignments and not permanent identities. Unannotated or reassigned IDs strictly default to UNCLASSIFIED with no automatic annotation inheritance.
